author: Forbes
description:
Marcus Shaw, CEO of AltFinance, joins Forbes senior writer Jabari Young on The Enterprise Zone from the Milken Institute Global Conference in Beverly Hills. Shaw discusses the mission behind AltFinance, a nonprofit, to create better pathways to careers in private investment for HBCU students. In the interview, Shaw also reflects on his career as a Wall Street trader, growing up in Maryland, his football days as a field goal kicker attending Morehouse College, and shares his perspective on the state of the financial markets.

Maybe you feel the Sunday Scaries. Maybe you're burned out. Maybe you got a better offer. Maybe you just feel stuck.
In this first episode of The Work Hotline, Sho Dewan (your work hype man, ex-recruiter, and founder of @workhap) breaks down how to know if it's actually the right time to quit in today's job market and what to do next!
Because quitting in 2026 is not the same decision it was a few years ago. The job market changed. Leverage changed. And the smartest career moves today look different.
